title: Always await/catch copyTextToClipboard before showing a success notification
answers: Success toast shown even though clipboard copy failed
Copy link to clipboard shows success but nothing was copied
body:
Symptom: a 'copied to clipboard' success notification appeared even when the copy actually failed (e.g. clipboard permission denied).
Root cause: `copyTextToClipboard`/its predecessors were called without awaiting the returned promise, so the success notification fired unconditionally right after the call.
Fix pattern: wrap the call in try/await and only dispatch the success notification inside the try, logging/dispatching an error notification in the catch — see public/app/core/utils/shortLinks.ts:createAndCopyShareDashboardLink and public/app/features/explore/RichHistory/RichHistoryCard.tsx (onCopyQuery) for the pattern.
Constraints: applies to every caller of copyTextToClipboard; fire-and-forget is only acceptable when there is no user-visible success/failure feedback tied to the call.
applies: Any UI action that copies text to clipboard and then shows a success/error notification
says: Success toast shown even though clipboard copy failed
Copy link to clipboard shows success but nothing was copied
search: Always await and catch copyTextToClipboard before showing a success notification, since the promise may reject if clipboard permissions are denied or the copy fails. Wrap the call in try/await, dispatch the success notification only inside the try block, and log/dispatch an error notification in the catch block. This pattern applies to every caller of copyTextToClipboard except when there is no user-visible feedback tied to the call; fire-and-forget is acceptable only when copy failure has no UI consequence. See public/app/core/utils/shortLinks.ts:createAndCopyShareDashboardLink and packages/grafana-ui/src/utils/copyToClipboard.ts:copyTextToClipboard for reference implementations.
